description: This file contains C# classes related to code generation testing within the Orleans framework, including a POCO class and a test class implementing a generic factory interface with an asynchronous method.

classes.name: CodeGenTestPoco
classes.description: A simple POCO class with an integer property used as a base class for testing code generation.

classes.name: FeaturePopulatorCodeGenTestClass
classes.description: A test class that inherits from CodeGenTestPoco and implements a generic factory interface with an asynchronous Product method.

methods.name: Product
methods.description: Asynchronous method implementing IFactory's Product, delays for 100ms and returns the input.
